description: wakewordlab 'hey jarvis' at a strict 0.7 threshold — fewer activations (lower false-accept, higher false-reject) than the 0.5 default.
notes: Threshold variant of wakewordlab-hey-jarvis. The VAD gate (config.hotwords.hey_jarvis.vad / vad_threshold) is built into the plugin's own config block, not a separate listener.VAD pipeline stage — do not expect a listener.VAD block when diffing this against the openWakeWord -silero combo fighters.
